messages.subject: Project Indigo - EXCHANGED
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

We have exchanged contracts this afternoon on Meridian Quarter at £14,250,000. The 10% deposit of £1,425,000 has been paid to Pendle Voss as stakeholder. Completion is fixed for 12 February 2026. We now move to the completion workstream: DS1/undertaking, option to tax, rent deposit assignment and tenant authorities.

Congratulations to the team.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
